messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — found a redirect in runtime/examples/batcher.md pointing at the old S3 URL. curl on staging returns 403, so the example fails for new users. Who owns these runtime examples? I can open a tiny PR to swap the link to the CDN.
alex: I think docs owns the content side but the file lives in eng-runtime repo. @chen might be the owner for that folder.
chen: yep, that’s in eng-runtime. I’ll take this unless someone else is already on it. can you paste the curl output?
marta: here’s what I ran:
```
$ curl -I https://old-s3.company.net/runtime/examples/batcher.md
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location: https://old-s3.company.net/redirected/path

$ curl -I https://old-s3.company.net/redirected/path
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```
marta: looks like the object was removed and the redirect chain breaks.
docs-bot: Automated docs-scan flagged 1 broken redirect for /runtime/examples/batcher.md (rule: s3-redirect-vs-cdn).
tyler: if you’re strapped for time I can open the PR to replace the S3 link with the CDN path and add a short note about the change.
marta: appreciate it — please do. tiny change: swap URL and add a one-liner at top: "Note: asset moved to CDN; old S3 may 403."
alex: also while you’re there, there’s an inline reference to model-onboarding.md that still points to the older slug. quick find/replace should fix it.
chen: grabbing the repo now. I’ll open a branch, push a fix for both links, and assign to @docs-team for review.
marta: thanks — tagging docs for review: @docs-team :thumbsup:
tyler: once PR is up ping me and I’ll do a quick sanity check on staging.
chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/482 — includes CDN swap + onboarding link fix + short note.
marta: LGTM, thanks!
alex: thanks all. we should add this pattern to the runbook so future scans get faster triage.
chen: noted, will add a follow-up runbook item in the PR description.
marta: perfect — closing this thread after review.
